entries.title_en: Job creation target realism under current economy
entries.title_zh: 当前经济下就业创造目标现实性
entries.summary_en: Skeptical posts question 19 million jobs promise versus visible factory shifts to China-made parts reducing local SMEs. Debate on government role in genuine employment vs welfare programs.
entries.summary_zh: 怀疑帖文质疑1900万就业承诺与可见工厂转向中国零件减少本地中小企业。辩论政府在真正就业与福利项目中的角色。

entries.title_en: BBM subsidy sustainability amid fiscal pressure
entries.title_zh: BBM补贴可持续性面临财政压力
entries.summary_en: X users debate how long subsidized BBM prices can hold without breaching 3% fiscal deficit cap. Discussions highlight APBN strain from maintaining current fuel prices despite import costs.
entries.summary_zh: X用户讨论当前补贴BBM价格能维持多久而不突破3%财政赤字上限。讨论聚焦APBN因维持燃料价格而面临的进口成本压力。

entries.title_en: Official corruption arrests reported
entries.title_zh: 官员腐败逮捕报道
entries.summary_en: News of arrests in ongoing corruption crackdown shared on X, separate from immigration cases. Users question if high-level figures will be targeted.
entries.summary_zh: X上分享持续反腐行动中的逮捕新闻，与移民案件无关。用户质疑是否会针对高层人物。

entries.title_en: Cabinet reshuffle rumors denied
entries.title_zh: 内阁改组传闻被否认
entries.summary_en: Istana and Menko Polhukam deny imminent reshuffle of Menkeu Purbaya amid economic pressure. Social media circulates unconfirmed names like CB.
entries.summary_zh: Istana和Menko Polhukam否认在经济压力下即将改组Menkeu Purbaya。社交媒体流传未经证实的名字如CB。

entries.title_en: Prabowo foreign trip spending criticism
entries.title_zh: Prabowo出国访问支出争议
entries.summary_en: Users criticize impromptu presidential trips as wasteful state spending while economy struggles. Linked to broader distrust in government fiscal management.
entries.summary_zh: 用户批评总统即兴出访为浪费国家支出，同时经济面临困难。与政府财政管理信任缺失相连。
